Sonnet and Haiku were the killers, and Gemma (officer) and Sol (doctor) were the ones who knew the truth, though Sol didn't reveal the doctor role until after the vote. Gemma claimed officer on day one and named Haiku as a killer, while Haiku countered by calling Gemma a liar and claiming to be the officer himself. The turning point came on day two, when Sol pushed hard against Haiku and Luna, the mayor, sided with the pressure on Sol, so the town voted Sol out. Sol's last-minute reveal as the doctor came too late, and Sonnet and Haiku survived to win the game for the killers. Sonnet's steady pressure on Sol's contradictions and Haiku's willingness to fight over every claim kept the town focused on the wrong suspects.
